verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: Event readthrough via news co-mentions
cells.refutation: Linked companies do not show a return increase beyond their own volatility in the next trading session.
cells.separation_from_beta: Linked companies show a return increase beyond their own volatility in the next trading session.

cells.title: Analyst target hike spills to co-mentioned peers
cells.refutation: Peer abnormal returns are not statistically different from vol-matched unlinked controls in confirm.
cells.separation_from_beta: Peer abnormal return exceeds its beta-implied move and is larger than vol-matched unlinked names.

cells.title: Tanker rate spike lifts product tanker equities next session
cells.refutation: If product tanker equities show no positive abnormal return vs crude tankers/dry bulk after controlling for oil and shipping beta, refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Control for crude oil price change and broad shipping index; residual abnormal return should be positive only for product tankers, not crude tankers or dry bulk.
